reviews.x: I hope they come out with more colors. I used two coats, but you definitely do not need more than 1 coat it covers so well I just couldn't believe it I love it. The bottles are small but they will go a long way,will definitely purchase again
They go on smooth and have great coverage.  The polish is long lasting.  I had the first set on for 2 weeks without any sign of chipping or peeling.  I will purchase from this company again.

I normally pay up to $50 to get my nails painted at a salon.  Due to covid I started doing it at home. I'm no professional but I can by with a week or 2 without them chipping.  They didn't come with a nail dryer but I got a really cheap 1 from Amazon and its working out great for me.

reviews.t: I finally have long, strong nails!!!
reviews.x: I have never been able to grow my nails long. They were thin and broke easily doing dishes, yard work, etc. Since buying this polish set and using it with the nail dryer I now have long nails that don't break. The polish is hard to remove, but with a little work, it can be done. I saw reviews mentioning small bottles. All I can say is a little goes a long ways and how many bottles of polish have you thrown out cause it sits so long. This is a good quality. Must be used with nail dryer!

The colors are absolutely gorgeous! I have not used these yet but I plan n using them tonight. I opened them and looked at the colors and I was in shock of how bright and beautiful they are. Absolutely recommend!
Smaller than I thought the container would be, but still love them!
It works!....Good buy!....You do need the uv lamp to perfect it.

I have tried many different kinds of gel polish to use at home with my UV/LED nail lamp and syntus has by far been the best and lasts the longest. The other brands I have tried peel off after a couple of days but syntus stays on my nails for a solid 2 weeks.

These colors are very vibrant and I love it. This is only 2 coats The light blue may need 3 coats depends on your preference But overall I am excited to try the different colors. Great purchase for my collection

Love the assortment of colors and the fact that they came with a base coat and top coat. They work great with my little UV lamp dryer. Not as sticky as some of the others. You still need to wipe them with alcohol when done but they last long and look great. I wish I could order larger bottles of the top and base coats.

reviews.t: Works Great if you follow the directions.
reviews.x: Good quality polish.  If you follow the instructions your polish will last as long as a professional application. On my first attempt the polish lasted for three weeks with no lifting.

I wrote a review and submitted but it didn’t go through so rewriting this one. Knocked off a star because the colors are neon and not like shown. I expected a burnt orange color not neon. Highly pigmented and the consistency is runny. The top coat is thick so not much required.

I was surprised that the bottles of polish were so small, but after thinking about it I like that. I tend to like to use new colors almost every time and this gives me the ability to without several full sized bottles just going to waste. The polish lasts for about a week before it starts chipping on me. But that’s with me picking at them and a toddler.
First time I order this brand can’t wait to try it for some reason one was leaking witch it happen with other brand but they look cute can’t wait to try
Long lasting colors are vibrant. Easy to apply and work with. Good quality if your a beginner. No more Salon manicures for me!

reviews.t: Stays on long, gold and silver kinda suck though
reviews.x: I hadn’t polished my nails for years because I didn’t think it was worth it with them getting all chipped up so quickly. This stuff is great! Even with doing yard work and stuff, it stayed on for a week before starting to show any signs of wear and looks really shiny and pretty. I have one complaint, and that is that the gold and silver aren’t quite like the picture - they’re just clear polish with some rather sparse glitter in it, so sadly, they aren’t really good to use on their own. reviews.t: Fantastic beauty on a budget paint set!!
reviews.x: I  not very good at doing manicures and pedicures, but this polish set, along with a UV light I bought off Amazon has given me so much confidence! It goes on so smooth and dries quickly. Absolutely no bubbles! You cannot beat the price! The color selection is amazing! From bright and cheerful to glamorous and dramatic! Totally the best thing I've gotten to boost my self esteem and confidence in being able to do my own nails.

reviews.t: Gel is very thick (not in a good way) and gloopy!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:3bec3ff3125b686bfda71dbb662642e4]] The colors are amazing! BUT the actual gel itself is VERY gloopy and thick, I’m sure it’ll be a bit of an issue while trying to cure.
I should have read the description better because had I known these were so small I would have picked a different option especially since the polish is so thick.
Super shiny polish and cured very quickly under the light!! Hopefully will not chip easily, but I worked in the yard yesterday and so far so good.
I love the way this polish goes on so easily and even just one coat is beautiful! The colors however were much more neon than I was expecting.

I love these small little bottles of gel fingernail polish. Bright colors. Take your time when applying. Don't make the coats too thick. Quick drying when done correctly and again not to thick. Easy to apply and remove. My only issue is they don't last that long. Some of my nails peel up and off within 2 days causing the need for frequent re-application. But overall, good product for the price. Just have patience.

These gel polishes are wonderful and I really enjoyed them until I began to notice small bumps forming on my finger by my cuticles. I initially attempted to treat it with a prescription  steroid cream and it didn’t get better so I finally decided to take off the gel polish. I’ve read horror stories of what can happen if you don’t treat them so I decided to return the product.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the vibrant, gorgeous colors and wide assortment in the set.
Many say the polish applies smoothly with great coverage and lasts long, often up to two weeks or more without chipping.
Several reviewers note the bottles are smaller than expected, though some see this as a positive for avoiding waste.
Multiple reviewers mention needing a UV/LED lamp to get the best results.
A few reviewers note drawbacks like colors appearing neon rather than as shown, runny consistency, or difficulty removing the polish.
